description: MCP server giving AI agents SSH, SFTP, PTY shells and remote screenshots
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path "$home\.fast-mcp-ssh\hosts.toml")) { Set-Content -Path "$home\.fast-mcp-ssh\hosts.toml" -Value '# fast-mcp-ssh hosts configuration - add your hosts here (see https://github.com/klNuno/fast-mcp-ssh)' }
notes: Config lives in the default ~\.fast-mcp-ssh directory (hosts.toml, keys, known_hosts.toml, audit.log); an empty hosts.toml is created on first install. A --config <path> argument overrides the location. To use a different directory, set the FAST_MCP_SSH_HOME environment variable yourself.
